tasks.title: Draft Harness v2 RFC/spec/tasks artifacts
tasks.goal: Create the rollout spec, RFC plan, and machine-readable tasks to drive implementation and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: RFC includes phase backlog, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and rollout/rollback notes.

tasks.title: Add full .codex Harness v2 role pack
tasks.goal: Introduce project-scoped role configs and orchestration policy pack for Harness v2 operation.
acceptance_criteria: All required role TOMLs exist and are referenced from .codex/config.toml.
Operating pack documents patterns A/E and gate requirements for high-impact work.

tasks.title: Add harness lint, preflight, and eval docs
tasks.goal: Provide executable governance checks and deterministic eval assets for Harness policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: Harness lint validates pack invariants and exits non-zero on policy drift.
Preflight runs doctor + lint and emits pass/fail summary.
Eval docs define deterministic run protocol and thresholds.

tasks.title: Add autonomy.harness config model + schema + docs
tasks.goal: Add first-class harness configuration in runtime model, defaults, validation, schema, and docs.
acceptance_criteria: autonomy.harness keys load with safe defaults.
Invalid harness config values are rejected by validation and schema.

tasks.title: Add harness preflight command and feature-aware doctor checks
tasks.goal: Add `autocodex harness preflight` and Codex feature capability checks in doctor.
acceptance_criteria: `autocodex harness preflight --strict` executes doctor + harness lint checks.
Doctor surfaces missing required Codex features as warnings/errors with actionable details.

tasks.title: Enforce high-impact council/critic/quality gate policy
tasks.goal: Block autonomy closure in high-impact harness mode unless council GREEN, critic GO, and non-blocking gates are present.
acceptance_criteria: High-impact runs fail with clear reason when gate verdicts are missing or negative.

tasks.title: Add lifecycle and admission metadata to run events
tasks.goal: Emit deterministic lifecycle/admission metadata and event types for replay/debugging.
acceptance_criteria: Run events include run_id, idempotency_key, attempt, admission_decision, queue_state, retry_backoff_ms.

tasks.title: Finalize verification, docs, and rollout notes
tasks.goal: Complete gate matrix, finalize docs updates, and produce rollout/rollback evidence for closure.
acceptance_criteria: Phase gate matrix and evidence checklist are completed.
Docs clearly describe harness mode and how it differs from coordinator/collaboration.
